The '''A280-K blaster rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]],<ref name="TSB" /> a variant of the [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifles]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]].<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], during the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]], [[Katarn Commandos]] member [[Gottu]] carried an A280-K blaster rifle.<ref name="TSB" />
